Title: ITCZ
Content: The Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) is a band of low atmospheric pressure where prevailing winds generally blow toward the equator and come together. As the `text(Sun's)` direct rays move northward from the equator after the Northern Hemisphere's spring equinox, the ITCZ also moves northward. As the `text(Sun's)` direct rays move southward from the equator after the Northern Hemisphere's autumnal equinox, the ITCZ also moves southward. This northward and southward movement shifts a greater distance over land than over water.
